protocol.SS_definition: Four distinct unordered source pairs absent from all training slots; both sources seen in both roles in both B and D8; query absent as a training query.
protocol.UU_definition: Sources absent from all active training roles; exclude all validation queries and source11; same query and ordered hops as SS.
protocol.model: GGNNLikeModel unchanged; COORDS_OFF at all nodes
protocol.deadline: External supervisor from command entry, including imports, verification, reconstruction and all final measures; kill worker at the global 120s deadline.
protocol.gate: B primary: both seeds COMPLETE, finite, exactly250 updates, final train/SS/UU>=.98; report D8 separately without selection.
protocol.XOR_readiness: Primary B gate plus AUX_OLD>=.98 in both B seeds, including query61; known challenge, not blind validation and not automatic authorization.
protocol.incomplete_runs: Preserve partial states and NOT_RUN; no retries, extra seeds, updates, orientation selection or extension.

hypotheses.scope: One Grid, one physical curriculum, two fresh initialization blocks; exploratory orientation contrast, not MHU evidence or population confirmation.

H-R4.proposition: At the fixed 250-update budget, balanced role assignment produces a reproducible material advantage in UU selection accuracy over D8 with the same physical curriculum.
H-R4.support_weak: B passes train, SS and UU >=0.98 in both seeds, and B minus D8 UU accuracy >=0.10 in both paired seeds.
H-R4.contradict_weak: D8 passes train, SS and UU >=0.98 in both seeds and B minus D8 UU accuracy <=0 in both paired seeds. This includes equal accuracy ceilings, and only contradicts the predicted accuracy advantage in this finite setup.
H-R4.limit: Orientation changes source-role support and marked-context diversity (12 vs 11 unique oriented triples). Train failure does not isolate transfer. Two initializations share one skeleton/geometry. A ceiling does not exclude loss, speed or other-task effects.

update_policy.eligibility: Exactly all four registered B/D8 runs at seeds2103/2104 COMPLETE, finite, 250 updates; full train/SS/UU final measures and verified frozen identities.
update_policy.ineligible: No update on partial/resource/numerical/identity failure; retain records.
update_policy.method: One ordinal update from the joint package, no manufactured probabilities or Bayes factors.
update_policy.H_R1_H_R3: Historical registers unchanged; their prior operational tests are not redefined as B versus D8.
update_policy.AUX_OLD: known challenge, outside H-R4 update; independent prospective readiness guard for any later XOR proposal

hypotheses.stop_policy: Exactly four runs, hard global120s, final checkpoint250 only. B primary gate train/SS/UU>=0.98 both seeds; XOR readiness additionally AUX_OLD>=0.98 both. No automatic fifth run, XOR, MHU, 3D or multilayer training.
